ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is time, and the vertical axis is runoff/precipitation; there are two water-level hydrographs, the dashed line is labeled “water-level hydrograph after urbanization,” and the solid line is labeled “water-level hydrograph before urbanization.” Then reason: comparing the highest points of the two curves, the peak of the dashed line after urbanization is clearly higher than the peak of the solid line before urbanization, so urbanization will cause the flood peak of the water-level hydrograph to rise.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the figure and answer the following question.

<image1>

What effect does urbanization have on the flood peak of the water-level hydrograph?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中横轴为时间，纵轴为径流量/降水量，有两条水位过程线，虚线标注为城市化后的水位过程线，实线标注为城市化前的水位过程线。再推理：比较两条曲线的最高点，城市化后的虚线峰顶明显高于城市化前的实线峰顶，因此城市化使水位过程线的洪峰增高。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route relies on directly comparing the plotted peak heights of the two labeled hydrograph curves, so it is the most image-reading-based solution.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the vertical axis as runoff/water depth and identify the two curves: the dotted curve labeled “城市化后的水位过程线” and the solid curve labeled “城市化前的水位过程线”. Compare their highest points; the post-urbanization dotted curve reaches a higher vertical position than the pre-urbanization solid curve.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question to focus only on the effect of urbanization on the flood peak, not on the timing of the peak.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In a water-level process line, the flood peak corresponds to the maximum water level/runoff value on the curve; a higher vertical maximum means a higher flood peak.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中城市化后的水位过程线比城市化前更陡，洪峰滞后时间更短，峰形更集中。再推理：根据城市化导致不透水地面增加、下渗减少、汇流加快的水文规律，同一降水过程下径流更集中，水位过程线峰值会上升。因此城市化对洪峰的影响是使洪峰增高。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中纵轴表示径流量/降水量，横轴表示时间；虚线标注为城市化后的水位过程线，实线标注为城市化前的水位过程线。城市化后的水位过程线更陡、峰形更集中，且虚线的洪峰高度明显高于城市化前的实线洪峰。再推理：城市化使不透水地面增加，下渗减少，地表径流增多并汇流加快，因此同一降水过程下水位过程线峰值会上升。结论：城市化使洪峰增高。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route uses the visual evidence of shortened lag/steeper hydrograph plus hydrological mechanism of urbanization, rather than only comparing the two maximum heights. It is related but uses a causal bridge, so it is weakly distinct from the direct comparison method.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read that the diagram labels the post-urbanization flood peak lag time as shorter than the original lag time, and the post-urbanization curve is steeper, narrower, and visually taller than the pre-urbanization curve.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question’s keyword “城市化” to invoke the urbanization-runoff mechanism, and use “洪峰” to identify that the required conclusion is about peak magnitude.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Urbanization increases impervious surfaces, reducing infiltration and causing rainfall to become surface runoff more quickly and more concentratedly; concentrated runoff generally raises the flood peak.
